actions.summary: Ask landlord to authorize appliance attendance at the stated minimum charge.

source_citations.quote:
Address: Flat 18, 108 Lantern Quay, Westmarsh, ZZ6 1ZZ

Good afternoon, The tenant from this property has reported the following -

'Hey, the washing machine isn't spinning when it comes to the end of a cycle with washing inside the washer. No matter the cycle, with clothes in it doesn't spin/drain resulting in powering off the machine and draining it mainly front the front drain pipe. The cycle says at "0:01" minute left indefinitely as it continues to spin, presumably to try and remove the water. I have cleaned/empited out the front filter and fully drained the machine twice since it started. Both times because the door wouldn't unlock due to water being left in the machine'.

We would advise for an appliance engineer to attend and this would cost a minimum of £65.00 + VAT. Can you please advise if you are happy for us to arrange this. Kind Regards, Noah.

actions.summary: Ask landlord to authorize investigation of washing-machine heating fault.

source_citations.quote:
Job reference: NBL-042
      
Address: Flat 20, 120 Alder Lane, Cedarford, ZZ9 0ZZ
      

Dear Mercer,

I hope you are well.

We have received a maintenance report from the tenant regarding the washing machine at the property.

The tenant has advised that the Harbour Surveying washing machine is not heating the water during wash cycles set to 60°C or higher. As a result, they are unable to properly wash clothing that requires higher-temperature cycles in accordance with the garment care instructions.

The tenant has confirmed that this issue relates solely to the washing machine and that there are no problems with the property's general hot water supply. Based on the information provided, it is possible that the appliance has developed a fault with its heating element or thermostat, although this would need to be confirmed by an engineer.

I have attached the photograph supplied by the tenant for your reference.

Please let me know if you would be happy for me to arrange for our appliance engineer to attend and investigate the fault.

Kind regards,

 

      Attachment(s):
